name: Kinoko ~Kindan no Chiryouyaku~
source:
Main character is a world famous fungi researcher working at a pharmaceutical company. Now he's developing vaccine for a strange infection that invigorates sexual desire draining energy till death. In fact, he's infected with it as well. Mixing mushrooms with bacteria provides unexpected results...

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/04/vn-of-month-september-2002-masaru.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主人公是供职于制药公司的世界知名真菌研究者。目前，他正在研发一种奇异传染病的疫苗。这种疾病会激发性欲，不断耗尽患者的精力，直至死亡。其实，他自己也已经遭到感染。将蘑菇与细菌混合后，实验却出现了意想不到的结果……

[引自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/04/vn-of-month-september-2002-masaru.html]vndbreview[/url]]
